text:
**My top pick is the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED's testing of 30+ models named it best overall.

## Top picks

| Need | Pick | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Best overall** | Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand | $109 list; WIRED shows $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy | 15W iPhone, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, tilting pad, landscape/StandBy support, 36W adapter included, 2-year warranty |
| **Fastest** | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | Qi2 25W, heavy base, 6.6 ft cable. No power adapter is included, so you need a 40W one (Nomad's is $25). |
| **Best budget** | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (15W) | $80 list, about $40 at Amazon per WIRED | Cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED found. The watch charger is a detachable unit, and the cap is easy to lose. |
| **Best for sleeping** | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | Lies flat so screens stay dark, or pops up for StandBy. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight. |
| **Best for travel** | Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2) | $110 list, about $80 on sale | Folds slim, 15W, 40W adapter included |

Buy links, from WIRED's roundups (Belkin, Nomad, ESR 15W, and Nimble are in the first, Anker in the travel one):
- [WIRED: Best 3-in-1 Apple Wireless Chargers](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- [WIRED: Best Apple 3-in-1 Travel Chargers](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

## Higher-end 25W options
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99):** Macworld found it the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand, with a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs. It's good as both a desk stand and a travel charger. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W ($99.99):** It has an active cooling fan, a 50W adapter, and a 30-day return window. Dealectric's page lists code PARTNER18 for $17.99 off, bringing it to about $82. [Buy at ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). That is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission. Prices and codes change, so check at checkout.

## Do you need 25W?
- Only the iPhone 16 and 17 series get the full 25W benefit. Per Dealectric's ESR listing, the iPhone 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus also get 25W, while other 16-series models get about 20W and older iPhones get 15W.
- WIRED notes that 25W "makes little difference if you charge your devices overnight."
- If you mostly charge overnight, the Belkin or the $40 ESR will do the job. Pay more for the Nomad or Satechi only if you want faster top-ups.
- Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging. The original AirPods case doesn't.

Sources: WIRED's two roundups above, the Macworld Satechi review, and the Dealectric ESR page (https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand).
